errors.error_description: Declared a signal using an escaped identifier that matches a SystemVerilog keyword (logic \always_comb ;), constituting improper use of a reserved word as an identifier.
Procedurally drove an input port inside the module (rd_en <= 1'b0;) violating port direction rules.
Declared an internal signal (unused_debug) that is never read or driven, resulting in a declared-but-unused signal.
Created an always_comb block that conditionally assigns hold_reg without providing a complete assignment on all paths, inferring a latch.
